title: A2A: Agent to Agent Protocol and How It Fits with MCP
summary: Colin McNamara explains Google's agent-to-agent (A2A) protocol and how it complements MCP.
learn: A2A lets you express in a simple JSON file what an agent can do, how to connect and how to authenticate.
LangGraph and similar tools handle workflow inside a graph; A2A handles messaging between agents and services.
A2A is complementary to MCP: MCP gives agents tools, A2A lets agents search a swarm for capabilities and delegate.
He says an implementation was about 300 lines of code at the time, and leaner ones had already appeared.
Use cases: recruiting, supply chain data exchange (EDI) and triaging customer support issues.
